name: no-native-tooltip-on-a-surface-that-draws-hints
description: hovering the floating address bar put a plain macOS tooltip on screen beside the designed hint bubble, because only the hovered button parked its own title and the URL input above it kept one. This run brings the bar up, hovers the copy link button, then reads every live title left anywhere in that document. A tooltip cannot be read back from the compositor, so the attribute it needs is the measure, and the capture is the visual check.

actions.note: ssh-launched Atrium is not frontmost on a clean snapshot
Developer Mode: the floating address bar

actions.expression: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('.dvcopy'); if (!b) { return 'no-button'; } b.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerover', {bubbles: true})); return 'hovered'; })()

(() => { const live = [...document.querySelectorAll('[title]')].filter((el) => el.getAttribute('title')); const path = []; for (let el = document.querySelector('.dvcopy'); el; el = el.parentElement) { if (el.getAttribute && el.getAttribute('title')) { path.push(el.className || el.tagName); } } return live.length + '/' + path.length; })()
actions.note: the whole document first, then the pointer's own path - macOS shows the nearest title at or above the target
The parked text is still reachable, and the control is still named for a screen reader
the first stream in a run can deliver no frames
One bubble, no plain tooltip beside it

assertions.desc: setup: the copy link button was hovered
No title survives anywhere on the surface, ancestors included
The label is parked, not lost
The designed bubble is the one hint on screen
